caveats: The Q4 value is derived, not directly reported. It is computed as full-year 2025 capex minus the nine-month year-to-date figure, which runs through 2025-09-28.

claims.text: Pfizer's capital expenditures (payments to acquire property, plant and equipment) in fiscal Q4 2025 were about $845 million. This is derived as FY2025 of $2,629 million less the nine-month figure of $1,784 million.

raw_output.summary: Pfizer's capital expenditures in fiscal Q4 2025 (2025-09-29 to 2025-12-31) were about $845 million. This is a derived figure: full-year 2025 capex of $2,629 million minus the $1,784 million reported through the first nine months.
